method: Targeted real text review after filtering outdated T01 participant voting instructions and clarifying Round 1 authority. No speech request; this is not a complete round rerun.

replies.text: You are weighing several individual proposals. The continuity plan lets the board authorize paper appointments and appoint an interim coordinator, but no alternate is currently named. IT support must verify backups and recovery dependencies before promising a restoration time. The communications lead must provide confirmed facts, state unknowns, and set a next update time, though no alternate channel exists. Insurers also require an incident contact and specific records. Which interim coordinator will you authorize to lead these operations and external communications while IT verifies recovery dependencies?

The executive director is the incident coordinator. No alternate incident coordinator is named in this plan.

T01-BCP:BCP-2
The board may appoint an interim incident coordinator using the exercise voting procedure.

T01-BCP:BCP-3
The service manager can operate an approved paper appointment process if the board authorizes its activation.

T01-BCP:BCP-4
IT support must verify backup usability, recovery dependencies and a restoration estimate before the
organization promises a service-restoration time.

T01-BCP:BCP-5
The communications lead must distinguish confirmed facts, unknowns and the time of the next public update. No
alternate communications channel is documented.

replies.text: From a governance perspective, the board must authorize an interim incident coordinator and approve activating paper appointments. IT support is an external supplier and cannot authorize board spending. We must check available funds and existing financial delegations for unforeseen operational costs. Individual members should consider whether these authorizations align with responsible resource oversight while technical checks continue.
